method.label: Use an isosceles triangle and similarity

annotationRationale: Isosceles-triangle properties produce the auxiliary parallel line. A parallelogram determines the longer base, similarity determines the diagonal, and the Pythagorean theorem determines AD. Radical simplification supplies the requested form.
sourceMethod: Follows the first official solution, constructing E at the intersection of CP and AB. The angle argument establishing EB = BC is shortened using CD parallel to EB.

review.mathCheck: The isosceles median gives CP parallel to AD. The parallelogram and equal angles give AE=EB=43, hence AB=86. Similarity gives DO=BD/3; therefore OP=BD/6=11 and BD=66. Pythagoras yields AD=√3040=4√190, so m+n=194, choice D.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 17's first approach on pages 10–11. It preserves the auxiliary point E, base calculation, diagonal ratio, and Pythagorean finish. The supplied figure confirms the A-E-B and D-O-P-B ordering.
review.annotationCheck: All six immediate nodes fit: cnm_137, cnm_271, cnm_272, and cnm_174 identify assessed geometry; cnm_183 and cnm_171 appropriately support opposite-side equality and radical simplification. The construction and deductions are reconstructible.
